_README: PARTLY REAL. Every figure comes from the real export except three that the 14-card layout added and were never computed from it: the words-per-person split (card 5), the goodnight / good morning counts (card 8), and which caption the peak-hour card gets (card 6). Run `npm run data` against the export to fill them. `npm run build` refuses to build while meta.placeholder is true.
